name: saas-settings-page
context: Design a settings and preferences page for a SaaS application. The audience is authenticated users managing their account, notifications, integrations, and workspace preferences. Target platforms: desktop (primary) and tablet. The interface must organize many options into logical groups without overwhelming the user, support instant-save and undo patterns, and clearly indicate which settings require confirmation.
constraints: All visual values must reference Design_Token (no raw hex, px, or rem values)
Follow typography.rules.json scale for section headings and option labels
Apply color.rules.json feedback tokens for save confirmations and destructive actions
Use layout.rules.json sidebar-content pattern with defined breakpoints
Form controls must follow Token_System sizing and spacing scale
Destructive actions (delete account, revoke) must use color.feedback.error tokens
All form inputs must have visible labels and not rely on placeholder-only patterns
Comply with Quality_Gate: logical grouping, proper form semantics, token-only styling

outputCriteria.format: Settings page spec with navigation sidebar, grouped form sections, save/undo controls, and token references
qualityChecks: Settings organized into logical sections with clear headings
Form controls use proper semantic elements (fieldset, legend, label)
Save and undo feedback uses Motion_Library state-transition presets
Destructive actions visually distinct via feedback.error tokens
All spacing and sizing uses Token_System scale values
accessibilityRequirements: All form inputs have associated visible labels
Related settings grouped with fieldset and legend elements
Save confirmation announced via aria-live region
Destructive action buttons have aria-describedby linking to warning text
Settings navigation supports keyboard with arrow key traversal

examples.description: Profile settings section with form fields, save bar, and destructive zone
examples.output:
Page: SettingsPage
  Layout: grid(columns: 240px 1fr, gap: var(--space-lg)) @desktop | stack @mobile
  Children:
    - Organism: SettingsNav(sticky, top: var(--space-lg))
        - Atom: NavItem(label='Profile', active=true, color=color.text.primary)
        - Atom: NavItem(label='Notifications', color=color.text.secondary)
        - Atom: NavItem(label='Integrations', color=color.text.secondary)
        - Atom: NavItem(label='Danger Zone', color=color.feedback.error)
    - Organism: SettingsContent
        - Molecule: SectionHeader(token=typography.heading.md, color=color.text.primary)
        - Molecule: FormGroup(fieldset, legend='Display Name')
            - Atom: Label(token=typography.body.sm, color=color.text.secondary)
            - Atom: Input(bg=color.surface.input, border=border.default, radius=radius.md)
        - Molecule: SaveBar(position=sticky, bottom=0)
            bg: var(--color-surface-elevated)
            shadow: var(--shadow-lg)
            - Atom: Button(variant=primary, label='Save changes')
            - Atom: Button(variant=ghost, label='Undo')
            motion: enter-exit.slide-up
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation and content use grid layout from layout.rules.json
All form elements have explicit labels with proper association
Save bar uses elevated surface token for visual separation
Destructive items use feedback.error token palette
Sticky positioning uses Token_System spacing values
